text: Joomi mon -ko onon yo yimɓe- ko Annduɗo fii mon, hay huunde suuɗanaaki Mo immorde e mon, si O yiɗii yurminnde on O yurminay on, ɗun woni O hawrinndina on e gomɗinal e golle moƴƴe. Si O yiɗii kadi nde O leptata on, O leptay on ɗun woni O woppa on gaayi gomɗinal O wara on e hoore keefereeku, Men nulaali ma -ko an yo Nulaaɗo- e dow maɓɓe fawtiiɗo sakko doolaaɓe e dow gomɗinal, haɗaa ɓe e immorde e keeferaaku, moftanaa ɓe golleeji maɓɓe ɗin. Pellet, an ko a yottinanoowo Alla ko O yamirmaa yottinngol kon.
